channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Player Grades: Brady Tkachuk scores, blown coverage in OT costs Senators in return from Olympic break
item.description: After celebrating their Olympic win for three days straight, Brady Tkachuk and Jake Sanderson led the way for Ottawa, but the Sens could only score once in a tight game against a division rival.

item.title: Return-to-office math doesn’t seem to add up, commercial real estate brokers say
item.description: Treasury Board unclear on whether current office space will be ready to host workers at four days per week in July.

item.title: 'Community hazard zones' declared by Ottawa school bus authority near downtown shelters, addiction treatment centres
item.description: OSTA will extend bus service for about 60 students who would otherwise have to walk to five downtown Ottawa elementary schools due to safety concerns such as shelters and drug consumption sites.

item.title: Interior design: Bathtub reboot
item.description: For years, the “death of the bathtub” has been declared with near-annual certainty. Showers are bigger. Bathrooms are tighter. Lifestyles are faster. And yet, step inside enough new residential projects and the tub hasn’t disappeared — it has evolved. “In recent residential projects, we don’t see tubs vanishing,” says Golara Ghasemi, creative director and principal […]

item.title: What are the Ottawa Senators' options with the NHL trade deadline set for next Friday?
item.description: The Senators face the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night but there are more questions looming on trade front.

item.title: Refugee and immigrant children less likely to go to hospital emergency for minor ailments: study
item.description: The study comes at a time when support for immigration among Canadians has been decreasing and pressure on the health system is among the concerns.

item.title: Government adjusting plan to offload office space due to looming return-to-office
item.description: Plans "underway" for PSPC to adjust its goal of offloading 50 per cent of its office space.

item.title: OC Transpo acknowledges slow going in O-Train axle repairs
item.description: There are still just 21 train cars available for Line 1 service, while 38 remain out of service for inspection and repairs. Those numbers have remained unchanged for several weeks.

item.title: Ottawa Senators' U.S. Olympians to face off against captain Auston Matthews and the Toronto Maple Leafs
item.description: Gold-medal memories are nice, but both Ottawa and Toronto have to make getting back in the playoff race their priority now.

item.title: Ottaw's PWHL players charged up by relationship with Capital City Condors
item.description: "I said to our team at the end of practice, 'The next 30 minutes is going to be the greatest experience of your week because you get a chance to fill your cup with these passionate hockey players.'"
